name: Sankalp Vidhi (Taking Vow before Puja)
applicability: Before starting any Hindu Puja or Fasting
steps: Sit on an Asana facing East or North.
Take water in the right palm with a Tulsi leaf and Kusha grass.
Chant the Sankalp Mantra: Om Vishnu... (stating place, time, lineage, and purpose).
Drop the water on the ground in front of the deity.

name: Shivratri Fast Vidhi
applicability: On the night of Maha Shivratri
steps: Wake up early, take bath with sesame seeds.
Wear clean clothes and visit Shiva temple.
Offer milk, water, honey, and Bel Patra on Shivling.
Do Jagran (stay awake all night) and chant 'Om Namah Shivaya'.
Break the fast next morning after sunrise.
